title: Added sugar caution
text: Foods with added sugar may be less suitable for people trying to control blood sugar, especially when eaten often or in large portions.

title: High sodium caution
text: Foods high in sodium may be less suitable for people with high blood pressure.

title: Peanut allergy
text: If a person has a peanut allergy, any food containing peanut should be treated as unsafe.

title: Milk allergy
text: If a person has a milk allergy, foods containing milk ingredients may be unsafe.

title: Saturated fat caution
text: Foods high in saturated fat may be less suitable for people trying to reduce cholesterol risk.

title: Whole food preference
text: Minimally processed foods with simpler ingredient lists are often a better default than foods high in sugar, salt, and refined fats.
